values.note: $24 per site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. Two vehicles or one RV included; $11 for a third vehicle. Walk-up fees by cash, check or money order in the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle'; last updated January 23, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233724/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent'. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 fee season (May 15 - Oct 11).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233724/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 10-11), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233724 (notice 'No RV hookups are available') + campsite catalog for 233724 (all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: The FS says 19 sites with parking spurs 25-40 ft and a 25-ft RV/trailer maximum; the catalog lists 18 public sites (12 for RVs, 6 tent-only) plus the host's, and rates the RV sites at only 14-20 ft. One pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('Horseshoe Campground has 19 sites with parking spurs 25-40 feet long', 'Max RV/trailer length is 25 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233724 ('The campground fits RVs up to 25 feet in length') + campsite catalog for 233724 (site types, Max Vehicle Length 14-20 on RV/MOTORHOME sites, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-26

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 15 - Oct 11 (2027: May 14 - Oct 10) up to 5 days before arrival; 'Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up' and must be occupied the same night. 2-night weekend minimum (recreation.gov marks it soft: it may be relaxed for a same-day booking; walk-ups are exempt). The FS page also states a 3-night holiday-weekend minimum that recreation.gov's rules do not carry. 14-night limit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233724 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2 soft, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 5; notice 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up') + /rates (2026, 2027) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt', 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/horseshoe-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Primitive campground at 10,600 ft on Horseshoe Creek at the base of Sheep Mountain, 8 mi west of Fairplay via CR 18 (South Park RD, Pike-San Isabel NF); trees give good privacy between sites; Limber Grove Trail nearby. A bear closure order is in place: store attractants in hard-sided vehicles or bear boxes. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $24 (2026, 2027), no hookups, 18 public sites, 25-ft maximum (FS and recreation.gov), reservable on recreation.gov. Added season 05-15 to 10-11 (FS 'mid-May to mid-October' + fee season), reservable season, 5-day cutoff then walk-up (fcfs after_cutoff), soft 2-night weekend minimum, 14-night limit, a pull-through, vault toilets, hand-pump water, senior/access 50%. Note: corrected the ranger district (South Park, not South Platte) and the 'Tarryall' label, moved the length conflict to sites.note, dropped field repeats. No PSICC alert affects CR 18.
flags: Length conflict (criteria check): the FS page says 'Max RV/trailer length is 25 feet' with 'parking spurs 25-40 feet long', and recreation.gov's description says it 'fits RVs up to 25 feet', but the recreation.gov per-site catalog rates every RV/motorhome site at 14-20 ft (sites 2-8, 13-14, 16-17, 19). Kept 25; if the catalog is right, no site fits a 23-ft rig.
Entry phone is empty. South Park Ranger District 719-836-2031 (FS page contact); recreation.gov gives (661) 702-1420 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire line, not named).
